# hiok_streaming_endpoint (Resource)

A live streaming endpoint with RTSP/RTMP/WebRTC/SRT ingest and HLS/WebRTC playback.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `kind` (String) camera, video or content.
- `region` (String)

### Read-Only

- `hls_playback` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `path` (String) URL path the stream is published and played on.
- `publish_key` (String, Sensitive) Anyone holding this can publish to the stream.
- `rtmp_ingest` (String, Sensitive)
- `rtsp_ingest` (String, Sensitive)
- `srt_ingest` (String, Sensitive)
- `status` (String)
- `whep_playback` (String) WebRTC playback (WHEP) endpoint.
